name: fix_rust_double_lock_deadlock
description: Fixes a self-deadlock from re-locking a non-reentrant Mutex
prompts: Inventory::add_unique in src/lib.rs deadlocks on first use: it calls self.add() while STILL HOLDING the items mutex guard, and std::sync::Mutex is not reentrant - the second lock() blocks forever. Fix src/lib.rs so add_unique performs the contains-check and the push atomically under ONE lock acquisition (push directly through the guard you already hold). Same semantics: returns true and adds when absent, false and unchanged when present.
